correctness.evidence: Independent derivation verified sys^2=1/y, quotient-distance reduction, both y-regime inequalities, cap/tail bounds, and equality locus; dense independent sampling was consistent with the exact 1/2 proof.

originality.evidence: Full-text comparison with arXiv:math/0304494 and arXiv:0803.0690 plus current searches and arXiv:2502.13715 found sharp/equality or conformal-factor defect results, but no explicit global deficit-versus-hyperbolic-moduli-distance inequality for flat tori. Judgment is relative to checked literature.

value.evidence: The result quantitatively upgrades Loewner rigidity on flat-torus moduli: small deficit forces O(sqrt(delta)) hyperbolic proximity to the hexagonal torus with an explicit global constant and cap.
